description.value: Waku North is a ramen and izakaya restaurant located in a commercial strip on Metral Drive in north Nanaimo. Specializing in Japanese ramen, it offers a sit-down dining experience with both lunch and dinner service across most of the week. Touring cyclists looking for a hot, filling bowl after a long day on the road will find this a solid stop in the Nanaimo area.
